Molecular Function:  
• Predicted to enable SNAP receptor activity; SNARE binding activity; and SNARE activity.

Biological Process:  
• Is involved in embryonic body morphogenesis.  
• Predicted to be involved in endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport; synaptic vesicle docking; vesicle fusion; and intracellular protein transport.

Subcellular Localization:  
• Is located in Golgi apparatus and adherens junction.  
• Predicted to be located in membrane and presynapse.  
• Predicted to be active in Golgi membrane.  
• Predicted to be part of SNARE complex.

Expression:  
• Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; excretory gland cell; nervous system; pharynx; and reproductive system.

Disease Relevance:  
• Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital disorder of glycosylation type II.

Orthology:  
• Orthologous to human STX5 (syntaxin 5).
